definitions.explanation: A device that removes solids or impurities from a liquid or gas by passing it through a filtering medium. Used in chemistry labs, water treatment, and industrial processes.

examples.english: We purify the water with a filter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{実験|じっけん}→実験：03273_jikken⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ろ{過器|かき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}った→洗う：00827_arau⟧。

⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧ろ{過器|かき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦ろ{過|か}→ろ過：15164_roka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: If you don't replace an old filter, its filtration performance drops.

notes:
Compound of ⟦ろ{過|か}→ろ過：15164_roka⟧ (filtration) + {器|き} (apparatus, device). The first part is usually written in mixed kana-kanji because the kanji {濾|ろ} is outside the ⟦{常用漢字|じょうようかんじ}→常用漢字：20778_jouyoukanji⟧ list.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ろ{過器|かき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a filter
- ろ{過器|かき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to replace the filter
